name: MRPC
old_description: MRPC is a world class, FDA Registered, and ISO 13485 certified full contract manufacturer of medical devices, instruments, and disposables. With full range product lifecycle capabilities including design assistance, development, and manufacturing, MRPC is a turn-key manufacturing partner to some of the world’s largest medical device companies.
about:
MRPC is based in Hudson, New Hampshire. The company does not publicly disclose its founding year, ownership structure, or the names of its founders.

MRPC operates as a full contract manufacturer specializing in medical devices, instruments, and disposables. Its service portfolio covers the entire product lifecycle, from design assistance and development through to manufacturing. Core production processes include silicone molding, plastic molding and extrusion, and multi-material molding. The company's output centers on finished medical device assemblies. Specific details such as facility square footage, employee headcount, annual production volumes, or part-number counts are not provided.

The firm targets the medical device sector, positioning itself as a turn-key manufacturing partner for some of the world's largest medical device companies. Its stated industry focus includes finished medical device assembly and automation-integrated scaling programs for complex medical devices. No individual customer names or case studies beyond the general description are cited.

MRPC emphasizes its FDA registration and ISO 13485 certification as markers of its quality and regulatory compliance. The company presents these credentials, along with its full-lifecycle capabilities, as the foundation of its value proposition to medical device manufacturers seeking a single-source partner.
